# REQ-1: Book a pickup slot

Status: Accepted

## Summary

Families queue for hours before the pantry opens, and a third of the parcels go unclaimed. The coordinator asks for a way for a family to book a pickup time in advance. Accepted into the pickups slice.

Last change: 2026-11-12, accepted into the pickups slice

## Who asked and when
The pantry coordinator, 2026-11-03, in the monthly volunteer meeting.

## What they said
> Half of them are here at seven and the doors open at ten. And on Fridays I throw away bread because the ones who booked on the phone did not come.

## The problem behind it
Today a family phones the pantry or just arrives. Volunteers write the phone bookings on paper, and nobody can see how many places are left. Other food banks use an online booking list with a fixed number of places per time.

## Evidence
One pantry, 31 of 120 weekly parcels unclaimed in spring 2026 (illustrative). How many families own a phone that can book online is unknown, and stays unknown until the first month of use.

## Decision
Accepted into the pickups slice: [PRD](../adopted/PRD.md).
